description: Return a paginated list of records visible in the list view for a model. Pass action_id to scope results to the action's domain (e.g. only draft orders). Pass context to control read behaviour — e.g. {lang: "fr_FR"} returns translated field values, {active_test: false} includes archived records. Returns {total, offset, limit, records[]} with the columns from the list view.
name: list_records
